why: The welcome page (Rejsekort's start, signed out), at its top: the app's logo band, its illustration, then Continue, a white pill the app fills, over How to travel with the app, words it draws without a fill that scroll the page down to its guide. Both stay in the page's list where the app draws them, Continue filled in the primary tone, at the middle of its line and across it as the app draws its pill (the view's tone where it stands says it is the app's filled button, so Relaid needs no reading of where its words sit, which this capture predates), How to travel with the app as the app draws it, unfilled, an item; so a device can still scroll down to the guide. The logo carries no words of Rejsekort's own (its description names Fairtiq), so the screen has no title and a device names it by the app.

why: The welcome page scrolled down to its guide, How to travel with the app: four sections, each a headline the app draws bold and larger than its body text over a few lines of text, beside an illustration (left out, as it has no words).
